name: Segment reference
description: Per-asset calibration CONTEXT: for the asset's segment (therapeutic area · modality · capital-position tier), reports how the framework's estimates compared to observed outcomes in a small, survivorship-flavored historical reference cohort. This is analysis context (directional, explicitly caveated), NOT a forecasting track record — the aggregate Brier dashboard, the public prediction log, and the log/resolve write endpoints were removed in the R2 rescope.
